summary: ElevenLabs Startup Grants give early-stage startups 12 months of free access to the full ElevenLabs platform at the Scale tier plus 33,000,000 characters — over 680 hours of Agents usage, valued at $5,500+. Covers Agents, Voice Design, Voice Cloning, Speech, Sound Effects, Music, and Image & Video. Eligibility: monetized product use case, valid business email, fewer than 25 employees, long-term product intent, no agencies/consultancies, no projects for minors, one application per company, existing enterprise customers excluded. Rolling applications; decisions within one week.
claim_steps: Apply at https://elevenlabs.io/grants-application with a valid business email and monetization strategy.
Eligibility: <25 employees, monetized use case, no agencies, one application per company.
Decision within one week; the grant plan and credits are applied to your ElevenLabs account for 12 months.
